using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Runtime;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Runtime.Tests
{
    public class InsideRuntimeClientLoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogDebug_ReceivedStatusUpdateForUnknownRequest_LogsExpectedMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var messageMock = new Mock<Message>();
            var diagnostics = new List<string> { "diag1", "diag2" };
            var status = new StatusResponse { Diagnostics = diagnostics };
            var messagingOptions = new SiloMessagingOptions { CancelUnknownRequestOnStatusUpdate = false };
            var cancellationManagerMock = new Mock<IGrainCallCancellationManager>();

            // Setup message properties
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.Result).Returns(Message.ResponseTypes.Status);
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.BodyObject).Returns(status);
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.TargetGrain).Returns(GrainId.NewId());
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.Id).Returns(CorrelationId.NewId());
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.SendingSilo).Returns(SiloAddress.NewLocalAddress(0));
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.SendingGrain).Returns(GrainId.NewId());

            // Setup logger to enable debug level
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(true);

            // Create InsideRuntimeClient instance with mocks
            var client = new TestInsideRuntimeClient(loggerMock.Object, messagingOptions, cancellationManagerMock.Object);

            // Act
            client.InvokeSendResponse(messageMock.Object);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Received status update for unknown request")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestInsideRuntimeClient : InsideRuntimeClient
        {
            private readonly ILogger _logger;
            private readonly SiloMessagingOptions _messagingOptions;
            private readonly IGrainCallCancellationManager _cancellationManager;

            public TestInsideRuntimeClient(ILogger logger, SiloMessagingOptions messagingOptions, IGrainCallCancellationManager cancellationManager)
                : base(
                    new TestLocalSiloDetails(),
                    new Mock<IServiceProvider>().Object,
                    new Mock<MessageFactory>().Object,
                    new Mock<ILoggerFactory>().Object,
                    Microsoft.Extensions.Options.Options.Create(messagingOptions),
                    new Mock<MessagingTrace>().Object,
                    new Mock<GrainReferenceActivator>().Object,
                    new Mock<GrainInterfaceTypeResolver>().Object,
                    new Mock<GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver>().Object,
                    new Mock<DeepCopier>().Object,
                    TimeProvider.System,
                    new Mock<InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache>().Object)
            {
                _logger = logger;
                _messagingOptions = messagingOptions;
                _cancellationManager = cancellationManager;
            }

            public void InvokeSendResponse(Message message)
            {
                // This method replicates the relevant part of SendResponse to test the logging call
                if (message.Result == Message.ResponseTypes.Status)
                {
                    var status = (StatusResponse)message.BodyObject;
                    // Simulate no callback found
                    CallbackData callback = null;
                    var request = callback?.Message;
                    if (request is not null)
                    {
                        callback.OnStatusUpdate(status);
                        if (status.Diagnostics != null && status.Diagnostics.Count > 0)
                        {
                            LoggerExtensions.LogInformationReceivedStatusUpdate(_logger, request, status.Diagnostics);
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (_messagingOptions.CancelUnknownRequestOnStatusUpdate)
                        {
                            _cancellationManager.SignalCancellation(
                                message.SendingSilo,
                                targetGrainId: message.SendingGrain,
                                sendingGrainId: message.TargetGrain,
                                messageId: message.Id);
                        }

                        if (status.Diagnostics != null && status.Diagnostics.Count > 0 && _logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug))
                        {
                            var diagnosticsString = string.Join("\n", status.Diagnostics);
                            _logger.LogDebug("Received status update for unknown request. Message: {StatusMessage}. Status: {Diagnostics}", message, diagnosticsString);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private class TestLocalSiloDetails : ILocalSiloDetails
        {
            public SiloAddress SiloAddress { get; } = SiloAddress.NewLocalAddress(0);
            public string Name { get; } = "TestSilo";
            public string ClusterId { get; } = "TestCluster";
            public string ServiceId { get; } = "TestService";
        }
    }
}
